{'text': "Following yesterday's release of the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is now rolling out the public beta as well. Here's everything you need to know.", 'Empty': False}

{'text': 'macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 Now Available', 'Empty': False}

{'text': 'Last week, Apple said it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and instead go straight to the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, before releasing Developer Beta 2 yesterday.', 'Empty': False}

{'text': "This move appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will launch with iOS 27.1 on October 23. It's possible that iOS 27.1 focuses primarily on features and changes tailored specifically to this new foldable device, which is why Apple is skipping straight ahead to 27.2 for its other operating systems.", 'Empty': False}

{'text': 'As for the current macOS 27.2 beta, the most noteworthy new feature is Siri AI gaining support for more languages, as Apple has promised this would happen by October. Starting with macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.', 'Empty': False}

{'text': 'The build number for macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is 26B5091g, which matches the second developer beta.', 'Empty': False}

{'text': "If you'd like to sign up for Apple's free public beta program, visit beta.apple.com.", 'Empty': False}
